com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.datamodel

Class LDAIConfigTypes.Tool

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.datamodel.LDAIConfigTypes.Tool
  • Enclosing class:
    LDAIConfigTypes

    public static final class LDAIConfigTypes.Tool
extends java.lang.Object
    A single entry from the root-level tools map of an AI Config flag variation.

    This is distinct from model.parameters.tools[], which is the raw array passed through to LLM providers. Instances are immutable; build them with builder(String).
